ash.bulkEdit.help:
Refactor preview
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move between changes and actions. Press Space to select a change. File operations and dependent text changes are selected together. Choose Open changes to review the selected replacements in a diff editor, or expand Show text change. Group by file or type to organize the changes. Press Ctrl or Command+Enter to apply selected changes. Press Escape to cancel. Changes to the source files disable Apply; cancel and run the refactoring again. Press Alt+F2 to read the full changes.

ash.output.help.overview: Output is a read-only editor. New output updates this view and any editor opened for the same channel.
ash.output.help.navigation: Use arrow keys to read output, Shift with arrow keys to select text, and Ctrl+C or Command+C to copy. Ctrl+F or Command+F opens Find.
ash.output.help.controls: Use Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the channel selector, filters, Clear Output, Auto Scroll, and More Output Actions. Text filters accept ! or - to exclude terms. Severity and category filters only affect this view.
ash.output.help.links: Place the cursor on a file location and run <keybinding:editor.action.openLink>, or click it while holding Ctrl or Command. Workspace file locations open at their reported line and column.
ash.output.help.scroll: Scrolling away from the end pauses Auto Scroll. Enable it to follow new output. More Output Actions opens the live channel in an editor or exports its retained text.
